stories.title: Add correctUnbornMasterDefault and ensureLocalPullRebase to git.ts
stories.description: New exported functions in src/modules/git.ts per architecture D1-D3, built on WP1's runGit.
acceptanceCriteria: correctUnbornMasterDefault repoints HEAD from master to main only when current unborn branch is exactly master (D2)
correctUnbornMasterDefault leaves any other branch name untouched
ensureLocalPullRebase distinguishes unset-locally from explicit-local-false via --local --get (D3)
ensureLocalPullRebase never overwrites an explicit local false
stories.testEvidence: test/init-git-state.test.ts: correctUnbornMasterDefault and ensureLocalPullRebase suites, real git fixtures. Two rounds of fixes: (1) during implementation, added an internal rev-parse --verify HEAD check so a BORN repo on master is never touched. (2) Adversarial review (independent subagent) empirically reproduced a HIGH-severity gap: the function checked the SOURCE was unborn but never checked the TARGET (refs/heads/main) didn't already have real history -- reproduced via git worktree-style orphan branch + pre-existing main, showing a silent history splice. Fixed with a third internal check (rev-parse --verify refs/heads/main must also fail); new dedicated regression test reproduces the exact reviewer scenario. Same review also found ensureLocalPullRebase only matched the literal string 'false', missing git's other falsy spellings (no/off/0) -- fixed via git's own --type=bool normalization instead of hand-matching; non-boolean values (merges, interactive) are correctly preserved as deliberate choices, never overwritten. New parametrized tests for both truthy and falsy spellings plus the non-boolean case.

stories.description: New test/init-git-state.test.ts using test/helpers/git-fixture.ts; extend test/init.test.ts's git mock factory to include inspectGitRepository without breaking existing tests (R8).
acceptanceCriteria: All existing test/init.test.ts assertions pass unmodified in behavior
New fixtures prove R2, R3, R5, R6 against real git
coverage on touched files meets the 80% repo-standard threshold
stories.testEvidence: 22 tests in test/init-git-state.test.ts (up from 12 after review-driven additions), all real-git fixtures, no mocking of src/modules/git.js in that file. Extending the git mock in test/init.test.ts surfaced a pre-existing latent issue (also present, separately, in test/update.test.ts, test/hub-retrofit.test.ts, test/session-continuity.test.ts): vi.restoreAllMocks() in several beforeEach blocks clears a plain vi.fn()'s configured resolved value, previously masked because the old code's numeric countUncommittedChanges > 0 comparison tolerated an undefined return silently -- the new code's gitState.status property access does not. Fixed in all four files by re-applying mock resolved values in beforeEach (matching the pattern already used for @inquirer/prompts mocks in two of them); an independent adversarial review verified this fix was real, correctly scoped, and applied to exactly the 4 files that needed it (grepped all git.js mockers). Adversarial review also found the new explicit-false-preserved warning path in init.ts had ZERO coverage (lcov confirmed) despite being exactly what EF-32's own 'Required tests' section asked for -- added a real end-to-end runInit test that seeds pull.rebase=false and asserts the warning actually prints (verified by watching it print during the test run, not just asserting a mock was called). Full suite (after all review fixes): 498/499 passing (1 unrelated skip), lint clean, typecheck clean. Coverage src/modules/git.ts: 94.5% line / 96.61% branch; src/commands/init.ts: 87.76% line / 92.07% branch.
